title: Ultimate Terrain level 3x the size of daggerfall 2x of UK, loading FAST and rendering in browser [Insane UPDATE]
author: Accomplished-Fan9568
selftext:
A landmass of 580x840km, a square tile of 1024x1024 km fully procedurally generated, variations with new seeds can be generated on the spot :)

Terrain level three times the size of daggerfall, twice the size of UK! Insane view distance!

I think it has great potential but I'm struggling abit with it but give some time and this will only get wilder. But heres a video, hope u enjoy. Any ideas will be noted.

comments.body: amazing work. what is your process? I am struggling with making open worlds for my projects so any tips/suggestions would be helpful. thanks

replies.author: Accomplished-Fan9568
replies.body:
Make a terrain with procedural noise then have it load in tiles, it gets complex as u go and it seems gemini 3.1 while less advanced keeps up with larger projects and is better for fine tuning.

Do everything procedurally. Gemini can do some 3d models too. All project is 1.1mb
